# WETYR Arena

> A weekly futures trading competition where winners earn real funded prop-firm accounts as prizes.
> Compete on a trading simulator for $5 a week, pass the challenge, finish top 3 in your division by
> consistency, and win a real funded account at a top-rated prop firm. No real-money trading, no
> brokerage account required, and a free alternative method of entry is available.

## What it is
- A skill-based trading competition operated by WETYR Corporation.
- Three divisions by simulated account size: Starter ($25K, $5/week), Pro ($50K, $10/week), Elite ($100K, $15/week).
- Winners (top 3 per division each week) earn a real funded or evaluation account at a partner prop firm such as Apex Trader Funding.

## How you win
- Reach your division's profit target during the week without breaching the trailing drawdown or daily-loss limit.
- Among everyone who passes, ranking is by consistency and risk discipline (no single day over 40% of total profit), the same profile a prop firm wants to fund. A bigger one-day gamble does not beat steady trading.

## Key facts
- Trading in the competition is simulated. The prize is real. No capital is at risk to compete.
- A free Alternative Method of Entry (no purchase necessary) is available for every competition.
- Prizes are third-party prop-firm accounts; WETYR Arena is a separate competition and is not affiliated with those firms unless stated.
- Instruments traded in the simulator: micro and mini CME futures (MES, ES, MNQ, NQ, MCL, CL, MGC, GC).
